time_zone.description: IANA time zone for watch schedules and answers like "this morning" (default UTC).

retention_days.description: Days mode: raw footage older than this is deleted; null keeps it until deleted.

retention_max_days.description: Maximum allowed for this account; null means no limit (self-host).

retention_mode.description: days (default): keep raw footage for retention_days. fill: keep as much raw footage as retention_max_bytes (or the deployment's storage cap) holds, deleting the oldest first. Clips, snapshots and events are kept until deleted in both modes and count towards storage.

retention_max_bytes.description: Byte cap for fill mode; null uses the deployment's storage cap, if any.

raw_bytes_per_day.description: Average raw growth over the last 7 days

estimated_days.description: About how many days of raw footage are kept at current usage (fill mode), or retention_days (days mode).

limits.description: Limits from the deployment's quota provider (null = unlimited). Self-host default: live view on, everything else null. Usage allowances are per month when the provider sets a monthly one, else per day.

max_live_viewers.description: People watching live at once across the account

plan_label.description: Display name of the account's plan, if the deployment has plans
